findings.title: Loopback security negative matrix omits declared request gates
findings.evidence: §96 mandates Sec-Fetch-Site=same-origin, Bearer-only auth, no cookie auth, OPTIONS write preflight rejection, no wildcard listener, and no token in URL/storage. Its explicit test list covers cross-origin, fake Host, no Origin/CSRF, content type, and GET only.
findings.required_change: Add independent tests for cross-site Sec-Fetch-Site with otherwise-valid headers, cookie-only and missing/invalid Bearer, OPTIONS/CORS behavior, listener bound address 127.0.0.1 only, and CSRF token absent from URL/browser storage. Each rejection must occur before Coordinator/Planner/Registry; retain valid same-origin control.
